1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 80 cm de longitud, con aletas radiadas, de color gris plateado; es comestible, aunque no muy apreciado. Haemulidae, Haemulon album.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 80 cm in length, with radiated fins and a silvery-gray color; it is edible, although not highly prized. Family Haemulidae, species Haemulon album.
